grid.origin: top-left cell first, rows run north to south
grid.sector: longitude 0-180 W, latitude 50-90 N, the pole inside; the corners of the rectangle reach further south

units.iceConcentration: percent of the sea surface (CIS total concentration, tenths x 10); 255 = land or no chart
units.iceClass: index into ice.classes: stage of development and floe form of the dominant partial concentration
units.glacier: 1 where Natural Earth maps glacier or ice cap over land, within longitude -150 to -15 only

method: GEBCO 15 arc-second cells averaged onto the grid (gdalwarp -r average). Shore: OSM land polygons inside longitude -150 to -15, latitude 45 to 86, Natural Earth land and minor islands beyond, rasterised at 750 m; a cell is land when more than 55% of it is land. Ice: newest chart per region burned in region order; water polygons are 0, no-data polygons leave 255. Places: GeoNames populated places with water within 2 cells.

sources.role: GEBCO 2024 sub-ice topography and bathymetry, 15 arc-second GeoTIFF release
